source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned test-only port requests a timeout multiplier of 2 for debug, coverage, ASan or TSan configurations. It leaves ordinary optimized loading outside the condition and keeps the existing memory minimization/report collection and detached-window diagnostics. The author describes one linked failure as slow, with a qualification. The source change and historical approval do not establish that every timeout was slowness, that window references were repaired, or that this is a general timeout policy.
title: The detached-window timeout extension is conditional and keeps the memory-report check
